stories.title: Trump, 'accordo con Danimarca e Groenlandia per controllo sicurezza isola'

en.title: Trump, 'agreement with Denmark and Greenland for island security control'
en.summary: Trump announced an agreement with Denmark and Greenland regarding security control of the island, stating the parties will retain full authority to act on the territory for its defense.

stories.title: Prof accoltellata, insulti social contro Isabella Marsilio dopo le parole sulla remigrazione

en.title: Stabbed professor, social media insults against Isabella Marsilio after her comments on remigration
en.summary: A teacher who described being attacked and reiterated her views on foreigners faced criticism and personal attacks on social media platforms.

stories.title: Trump: “Stipulato accordo per il controllo della sicurezza della Groenlandia”

en.title: Trump: "Agreement concluded for security control of Greenland"
en.summary: Trump announced an open-ended agreement for security control of Greenland through a post on Truth social media platform.

stories.title: Trump bandisce dalla Casa Bianca Cnn, Politico e Msnow

en.title: Trump bans CNN, Politico and MSNBC from White House
en.summary: Trump barred three media outlets from access to the White House.

stories.title: Trump bandisce dalla Casa Bianca Cnn, Politico e MsNow: "Diffondono notizie false"

en.title: Trump bans CNN, Politico and MSNBC from White House: "They spread false news"
en.summary: The U.S. president announced an immediate ban on three news outlets, prompting strong reactions from journalists. CNN stated the ban violates press freedom rights protected by the Constitution.

stories.title: L’editto del presidente Usa: “Cnn, MsNow e Politico via dalla Casa Bianca”

en.title: U.S. president's edict: "CNN, MSNBC and Politico out of the White House"
en.summary: Three news organizations have been denied White House access for consistently reporting false information. The New York Times publisher criticized the decision.

stories.title: Prof accoltellata da uno studente con tre colpi sotto l'ascella, ancora sotto shock

en.title: Teacher stabbed by student with three blows under armpit, still in shock
en.summary: A teacher was stabbed by a student she had previously given failing grades. Students said the student had previously stated an intention to attack the teacher, which they did not take seriously.

stories.title: Barilla to invest €100 million in the South, set up new pasta hub in Foggia

en.title: Barilla to invest €100 million in the South, set up new pasta hub in Foggia
en.summary: Barilla plans a 100 million euro investment in Southern Italy, establishing a new pasta production facility in Foggia that will serve as a strategic hub and create jobs.

stories.title: Ostuni, pescatore di 70 anni muore colpito da un fulmine sugli scogli

en.title: Ostuni, 70-year-old fisherman dies struck by lightning on rocks
en.summary: A 70-year-old fisherman in Ostuni was killed by a lightning strike while on rocks. A companion present at the time remained unharmed.

stories.title: Arabia Saudita, gli Houthi attaccano una base aerea: colpito Eurofighter italiano. Crosetto: “Nessun ferito”

en.title: Saudi Arabia: Houthis attack air base, Italian Eurofighter struck. Crosetto: "No injuries"
en.summary: Houthi forces attacked a Saudi air base, damaging an Italian Eurofighter jet. The defense minister announced the navy will escort merchant vessels in the Bab el-Mandeb strait, while Trump stated the U.S. is negotiating with the militia.

stories.title: La prof accoltellata a scuola: “Salvata da uno studente del Congo, ma resto a favore della remigrazione”

en.title: Teacher stabbed at school: "Saved by a student from Congo, but I remain in favor of remigration"
en.summary: A 66-year-old teacher was stabbed at a school in Rome's Collatina area. A student from Congo rescued her by spraying pepper spray on the attacker's face while recording the incident with a helmet-mounted camera.

stories.title: Arabia, colpito un jet italiano in una base sotto attacco. A Bab el-Mandeb scortata una nostra nave

en.title: Arabia, Italian jet hit at base under attack. Our ship escorted at Bab el-Mandeb
en.summary: An Italian military jet was struck at a base during an attack, with no military personnel involved. An Italian frigate in the Aspides operation escorted an Italian merchant vessel through the strait.

stories.title: Barilla investe cento milioni al Sud, nuovo polo della pasta a Foggia

en.title: Barilla invests one hundred million in the South, new pasta hub in Foggia
en.summary: Barilla is establishing an integrated pasta production facility in Foggia, Puglia, with a hundred million euro investment. The company is restructuring its industrial operations in southern Italy to improve sustainability and efficiency.

stories.title: Energia, «con questi prezzi le imprese lombarde rischiano di fermarsi»

en.title: Energy, "with these prices Lombard companies risk shutting down"
en.summary: An alert warns that Lombardy's economic system faces the risk of halting if current energy prices persist in the coming weeks.

stories.title: Nucleare, Edison punta al primo mini-reattore in Italia nel 2035

en.title: Nuclear, Edison aims for first mini-reactor in Italy by 2035
en.summary: Edison plans to build a series of ten mini-reactors across Europe worth tens of billions of euros, with the first facility to be constructed in Italy by 2035.

stories.title: Via al fondo Ligurcapital da 10 milioni per imprese e startup

en.title: Ligurcapital fund launches with 10 million for businesses and startups
en.summary: Ligurian startups and small to medium enterprises can apply from September 22 for equity and semi-equity funding ranging from 100,000 to 500,000 euros.

stories.title: Al via “Napoli città mondo” per promuovere la sua cultura e le sue imprese

en.title: Naples City World launches to promote its culture and enterprises
en.summary: A new cultural promotion program called Naples City World has been launched by Italy's Foreign Ministry to showcase the city's culture and business sector.
